trello.name: Add queue depth alerting across worker fleet
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Add queue depth alerts for the entire worker fleet (not just payment workers) with consistent thresholds: warning at 1,000 jobs and page at 5,000 jobs. Acceptance criteria: alerts configured and verified for all worker types.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic with backoff and dead-letter queue
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Fix the retry logic in payment_worker.py, specifically the _process_with_retry function. Implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap the number of retries, and on terminal failure route jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back rather than re-enqueuing at the front of the main queue. Add tests that simulate processor 503 responses to cover the retry-storm scenario. Acceptance criteria: no immediate retries, bounded retry count, failed jobs land in dead-letter queue, and new tests pass.

trello.name: Bump and split DB connection pools for workers and API
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. In one config change, bump the DB connection pool from the default 20 to 100 and split worker and API connection pools so they no longer share a single pool. Acceptance criteria: workers and API have separate pools, worker pool sized at 100, config deployed and validated.

trello.name: Refresh payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Owner: Priya (Kofi to confirm assignment with her after the meeting). Update the payment incident runbook to: replace old Kibana links with current logging links, document the queue drain procedure improvised during Tuesday's incident, and verify/fix escalation phone numbers (at least one currently routes to a departed employee). Acceptance criteria: runbook has working logging links, documented queue drain steps, and current escalation contacts.

trello.name: Automate status page update on checkout error alert
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Wire the status page provider API to the checkout error rate alert so that when the alert fires, the status page automatically flips to 'investigating' with a template message. Start with the checkout alert; other alerts can be extended later. Acceptance criteria: firing checkout alert triggers automatic status page update without manual intervention.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Draft a controlled chaos game day plan for testing the secondary payment processor failover, starting in staging then production during a low-traffic window, with a rollback plan. The plan must be drafted and reviewed by the team in two weeks before any execution occurs. Acceptance criteria: written plan delivered for review within two weeks; no execution until review is complete.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis from EOL 6.0 to 7.2
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Upgrade Redis from 6.0 (EOL, security fixes ended in June) to 7.2. Account for a config rename and changed persistence defaults; schedule a proper change window via the infra calendar rather than a casual deploy. Acceptance criteria: Redis upgraded to 7.2, config updated, persistence settings validated, deployed during a scheduled change window.

trello.name: Write and send incident timeline doc
trello.desc: Owner: Ines. Write up the incident timeline document tonight and send it out tomorrow. Acceptance criteria: timeline doc distributed to the team by tomorrow.

trello.name: Post team lunch headcount request in channel
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Post the Thursday team lunch details and headcount request for the Thai place in the team channel (not in the meeting). Marta is already typing it. Acceptance criteria: headcount request posted in channel with enough lead time for the restaurant.
